parent_objective: audit M2410 source-linked reset evidence before deciding whether to admit bounded measured validation
blocked_by: M2410 is reset-only evidence and cannot be interpreted as measured driver improvement
M2410 leaves unmatched source-key diagnostics that must be acknowledged before measured validation
supersedes: candidate family ranking from reset-only evidence

public_gates: M2411 must audit M2410 result_class and source-linked family coverage
M2411 must decide whether to admit bounded non-ranking measured-validation design, pivot, synthesize, or stop
M2411 must preserve unmatched source-key diagnostics
M2411 must not rerun reset, measured rollout, repair, training, replay, PPO, ranking, or verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the source-linked reset panel is admissible for bounded measured-validation design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no measured rollout, repair execution, training, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if M2410 reset evidence is incomplete
stop if unmatched source-key diagnostics are ignored
stop if the audit routes directly to ranking or current-sim verdict
stop if measured validation would require active config overwrite or actor input changes
fallback_plan: route to bounded non-ranking measured-validation design if M2410 evidence is accepted
pivot to source-key coverage repair if unmatched keys block measured validation
stop for branch synthesis if the result is reset-valid but not evidence-relevant
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: synthesize after at most 10 milestones in this branch or if another non-evidence chain appears

admission_evidence: 4/4 candidate families have non-empty source links
allowed_updates: M2411 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: audit accepts or rejects M2410 reset evidence
a bounded next route is selected or the branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2411 audits reset-only infrastructure and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2411; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If reset evidence is accepted but only supports executable subset coverage, route to measured validation with explicit unmatched-key caveat.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, effective-candidate ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a new source-linked reset panel before measured validation
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit measured-validation design but cannot establish measured performance or current-sim verdict
must_synthesize_if: another result audit is proposed without measured-validation design
unmatched source keys are used to avoid an evidence decision
five milestones pass without reset or measured evidence

hypothesis: Auditing M2410 will determine whether the source-linked reset panel is clean enough to admit bounded measured-validation design without ranking or verdict claims.
success_criteria: the audit accepts or rejects M2410 explicitly
a bounded non-ranking next route is selected or the branch is stopped
no measured rollout repair training ranking or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2411 reruns reset or measured validation
M2411 ranks candidate families or selects a winner
M2411 makes measured performance, current-sim, paper, FW-vs-GRU, or self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2411 passes if it audits M2410 reset evidence, classifies unmatched-key diagnostics, and selects a bounded non-ranking next route or stops without measured rollout, repair, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
